items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:34 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider two land acquisition matters, two land acquisition and disposition matter, one security of property and information that belongs to the municipality that has monetary value matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (a) (c) and (j) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
